address: Church Lane, Hallowby, near Kirkby Wold YO62 9QT
entry: Adults £1 on the gate, children free. Bring coins for the stalls.

Maypole dancing
items.note: Years 3 and 4 of Hallowby Primary School.

items.title: Fancy dress parade
items.note: Under-elevens. This year’s theme is the seaside.

items.title: Dog show
items.note: Six classes, £1 a class. Enter at the ring from 1.30.

items.title: Tug of war
items.note: The Plough against the cricket club.

items.title: Raffle drawn
items.note: First prize is a hamper from Hallowby Stores.

items.title: Cake auction
items.note: Whatever the tea tent has left goes to the highest bidder.

items.title: Teas and home-made cakes
items.note: A pot of tea, a scone and a slice of cake for £3.50.

items.title: Tombola
items.note: Every ticket ending in 0 or 5 wins.

items.title: Tower tours
items.note: Every half hour, £2. There are 68 steps and no handrail; not for under-eights.
